articles.title: Archer Aviation Unveils Air Taxi Networks in Dallas-Fort Worth, Houston and Austin
articles.summary: In the next few months, North Texans may see air taxis — with paying passengers aboard — in the sky. San Jose, California-based Archer Aviation (NYSE: ACHR) just unveiled plans for three air taxi networks in the Texas Triangle. They will connect airports and business districts within Dallas-Fort Worth, Austin and Houston. …

articles.title: Dallas-Based Disruptive Raises $10B Flagship Fund
articles.summary: Dallas-based venture capital firm Disruptive Technology Advisers has raised a $10 billion fund, its largest to date. The fund plans to invest up to $1 billion each in about 10 growth or late-stage companies, the firm said. It cited artificial intelligence, AI infrastructure, defense and national security as areas where it sees significant business opportunities in need of large amounts of capital. …

articles.title: Dallas-Based GDT Opens AI Lab Where Businesses Can Test Projects Before Buying Equipment
articles.summary: Dallas-based IT services provider GDT debuted a supercomputer-level AI lab that lets businesses test technology before adopting it. Attendees at the lab’s open house, held at the company’s Dallas headquarters Oct. 22, could watch AI demonstrations and ask GDT executives about AI trends. …

articles.summary: Led by community members from 11 counties, the group plans to address major concerns about broadband expansion and provide training on how to use technology.

articles.summary: Every data center developer that wants to build in San Antonio will have to get permission from City Council before it can begin construction.
